# Talo agent resources

- [Start integration](/agent/setup): Full implementation instructions for a coding agent. Optionally supply ?appId=YOUR_PUBLIC_APP_ID. No login or secret required to read.
- [Agent setup overview](/docs/agent): How to get the application-specific link.
- [Connection checker](/integrations/check.mjs): Inspect, then run with Node 22+ and your local environment.
- [Backend helper](/integrations/server-session.mjs): Adapt to the host authentication and server runtime.
- [API schema](/openapi.json): Endpoint contracts.

# Talo integration guide

Talo adds a documentation-based support widget to a website. Start at /docs/widget and /docs/server. Machine-readable endpoint schemas are at /openapi.json.

## Setup
1. Sign in to /dashboard; create an application and register exact HTTPS origins (HTTP localhost is allowed).
2. Add customer-facing documentation. Explicitly enable publication and save.
3. Copy the generated widget.js script tag. The app ID is public; the server key is not.
4. For identified support, generate a server key in the dashboard and store it only on the backend.
5. Implement an authenticated backend endpoint that derives the customer ID and allowed facts from trusted application state. POST /api/server/sessions without an Origin header, using Authorization: Bearer <server-key>.
6. Return the short-lived token only to the authenticated customer. On talo:ready call window.Talo.identify(token). Call window.Talo.clearIdentity() on logout/account change.
7. Verify two-customer isolation, wrong-origin rejection, expired tokens, key rotation, memory opt-in/forget, and team replies before release.

## Constraints
Tokens expire after15 minutes. They contain readable account facts, so do not include secrets. Supported facts: plan, subscriptionStatus, accountStatus, supportEmail. No actions or financial transactions are permitted.
Anonymous sessions do not have persistent memory. Verified customers may remember their last3 exchanges for30 days. Widget memory is scoped Neon storage, separate from playground Walrus storage.
Conversations are visible to the owning application's team for30 days, with hourly bounded expiry purge. Team inbox: /inbox. Replies are fetched by Check for reply, not email or push notifications.
Daily caps:100 widget questions per application,200 server sessions per application,20 AI attempts shared by this deployment. Never reset counters automatically.
Origin checks protect browser embedding, not private account identity. Never put a server key in browser code, accept browser-supplied customer IDs as verified identity, or claim a support answer changed account access.

## Customer insights
Owners can review /insights for conversation volume, verified-customer counts, repeat contacts, current handoffs and explicit customer feedback. Topics are English keyword groups with evidence links, not AI root-cause conclusions. Widget feedback is revision-bound and resets on a new message. No geography is collected.
